useWhen: You're ready to launch your product
You need a comprehensive launch plan
You want to coordinate across teams

workflow.description: Set launch date and work backwards
Break down each track into actionable items
Name responsible people for each task

examples.input: Launching a new B2B SaaS product to the public
examples.output:

If critical issues found:
1. Roll back to previous version
2. Postpone launch 1 week
3. Notify all stakeholders immediately
